verdict.rationale: All MCP-related evidence (docs-1, docs-14, docs-34, probe-2, probe-rt-1) describes PagerDuty as an official MCP *server* that external MCP-enabled clients can connect to — the opposite direction from this story, which asks whether a user can plug external MCP servers into PagerDuty so its own AI features (e.g., PagerDuty Advance, SRE Agent) can consume their tools. No evidence shows PagerDuty acting as an MCP client or supporting configuration of third-party MCP servers as tool sources.
